sentences.text: The meeting was held on Tuesday 24 November 2026 for a child in need review of the Haddon family, comprising Leanne (mother), Tyler (8 years old), and Amelia (7 months).
Leanne sent apologies; Amelia had a GP appointment that morning; Leanne requested information sharing but not with her mother, Sandra.
Tyler's attendance was 84% for the current term, mostly consisting of lates rather than whole days, particularly on Mondays.
Tyler has to prepare Amelia's bottles in the morning before he can attend school.
Tyler has had a couple of meltdowns at lunch; staff have discussed whether to refer him to CAMHS or consider ADHD, but no referral has been made.
A lunchtime supervisor reported second-hand that Jordan (Amelia's father/ex-partner) has been dropping Tyler off at the gate on a couple of mornings; no office staff have seen him.
Amelia is tracking on the 25th centile for weight; she has a cow's milk protein allergy and is on hypoallergenic formula.
Amelia has had a cough for three weeks and sleeps in the back bedroom which has mould on the wall behind the cot; the health visitor has photos of the mould.
The health visitor sees Amelia fortnightly; if her weight drops or her chest condition worsens, visits would increase to weekly.
Leanne scored high on the PHQ questionnaire and has stopped taking her sertraline; the health visitor heard this from Leanne's mother, Sandra, but has not confirmed it with Leanne.
The family lives at 22 Ashby Court, second floor, two-bed flat; the housing officer confirmed the rent account is clear with no arrears.
There is damp coming through the external wall of the flat; a surveyor is booked for Tuesday 1 December to assess it.
If the surveyor identifies a category one hazard, a management move or decanting could be considered; the housing officer could not confirm a date for the works.
The tenancy is an introductory tenancy subject to review on 11 January.
An anonymous complaint was received from a neighbour alleging shouting from the flat late at night a couple of weeks ago; the housing officer could not verify the complaint.
Leanne stated she has had no contact with Jordan since he left in June and he has not visited the flat; a police check confirmed no call-outs to the address since June.
Gareth Pryce expressed a concern that the Jordan situation should be referred to a child protection conference.
Hannah Brightwell and Ruth Lindqvist agreed there is no child protection threshold based on current evidence; the matter requires further discussion regarding Clare's Law.
S3 stated that the child is 'lovely' with Amelia and 'really attentive'.
S2 stated that Tyler 'adores' the child and 'talks about his mum all the time'.
S2 proposed offering Tyler a free breakfast club place at school, open every day from 08:00.
S2 stated that Tyler 'gets fed' at the proposed breakfast club.
S1 reported that she mentioned the breakfast club to Leanne on Thursday and that Leanne was 'keen'.
S2 stated that Tyler 'can start' the breakfast club on Monday the thirtieth.
S2 suggested that the mother would 'really benefit' from a parenting course run by the Family Hub on Wednesdays.
S1 reported that Leanne said 'no' to the parenting course, stating she felt it would be 'being told she's a bad mum'.
S1 reported that Leanne stated she 'would like' the stay and play at the Family Hub for Amelia to 'meet some other mums'.
S3 stated she could make the perinatal referral via an online form.
S1 stated she would talk to Leanne about the morning routine and whether a young carers assessment is 'appropriate' regarding Tyler and the bottles.
S3 asked if Tyler is 'making up formula' regarding the bottles.
S2 stated he 'doesn't know' if Tyler is making up formula, only that Tyler 'just said bottles'.
S3 stated she would ask Leanne about the hypoallergenic formula because it is 'fiddly'.
S2 stated he 'thanks' S1 for the room and 'the flask'.
S2 stated he 'mind[s] the car park' because they 'coned half of it off'.
A perinatal mental health referral is planned for Leanne by Friday 27 November.
S1 stated that Gareth's disagreement regarding the case staying at 'child in need' is 'noted'.
S2 agreed that Gareth's view that the case 'should go to conference' is 'fair'.
S1 stated that Tyler 'starts' the breakfast club on Monday the thirtieth.
S1 stated that Ruth 'makes' the perinatal referral by Friday.
S3 confirmed the deadline for the perinatal referral is 'By Friday'.
S1 stated that Ruth 'refers' Leanne and Amelia to the stay and play.
S3 stated the deadline for the stay and play referral is 'by the end of next week' (Friday the fourth).
S1 stated the deadline for the stay and play referral is 'Friday the fourth'.
S1 stated that Darren (the surveyor) is on Tuesday the first and will 'send' the report.
S4 stated he would 'aim' to send the survey report 'within a week' of the visit.
S1 stated that Gareth will 'send' the attendance breakdown.
S2 stated the deadline for the attendance breakdown is 'By Friday', with lates 'broken down by day'.
S1 stated she would speak to her manager about Jordan information and the Clare's Law question, and 'email everyone' by Monday the thirtieth.
S1 stated that the CAMHS matter was 'Not agreed' and 'Not today'.
S3 stated that the move to Sandra's 'is not happening'.
S1 confirmed that the move to Sandra's 'is not a decision'.
S4 confirmed that the management move 'is not agreed' and depends on the survey.
Hannah Brightwell intends to discuss Clare's Law with her manager and will email the team by Monday 30 November.
S1 proposed the next review be held on Tuesday the eighth of December.
S3 stated she is 'on leave' the eighth of December for 'that whole week'.
S1 proposed the next review be held on Tuesday the fifteenth of December at 10:00 at the school.
S2 confirmed the fifteenth is 'fine' and stated he 'will book the room'.
S4 confirmed he 'can do' the fifteenth and stated he 'will dial in again, probably'.
S3 confirmed the review date is 'Fifteenth, yes'.
S1 stated she 'will share' the meeting notes with Leanne.
S3 stated she 'will send' photos to S1 and Darren 'today'.
S4 stated the photos 'will help' with the surveyor.
